commonDescription: One male fantasy swordsman facing right in strict 2D side view. Preserve the red wide-brim feathered hat, large ivory feather, brown hair, red cape, cream shirt, dark fitted vest, brown boots and full-length sword. Preserve the reference design and proportions. Entire body and sword remain inside a fixed canvas. No dust, no glow, no background, no camera motion.
walk: A natural in-place walking cycle, alternating feet with planted support foot, knee bend, hip and shoulder weight transfer. Keep the sword grip, feather and hat unchanged. Seamless loop.
slash: A single side-view sword slash with forward weight transfer and a readable sword arc. Preparation, strike and recovery. Maintain consistent headgear and sword length. No teleport back, no extra weapons.
costPolicy: No new purchase. Record exact displayed cost before generation. Pending requests are resumed, never resubmitted blindly.
